segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Hi Dana, this is Mark with CalPro. Still a good time for the calibration tracking quote?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yeah, I have about fifteen minutes. We reviewed it this morning. The main question is seats. You quoted 24 named users, and we think 28 is safer for the lab supervisors.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yep, that works. At 28 seats the annual subscription is $31,920, and the onboarding stays the same at $4,800. So first-year total is $36,720 before tax.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay. And that includes the asset import, right? We have around 3,400 gauges and meters in the spreadsheet.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Correct. One asset import from your spreadsheet, two admin training sessions, and the certificate template setup. If the count lands a little over 3,400, that's fine. We're not charging by asset in that tier.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Good. Finance asked if you can invoice half on signature and half at go-live. Our target go-live is October 21st.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yes, net 30 on both invoices. First invoice on signature, second invoice on the go-live date, October 21st. I'll put that payment schedule in the order form.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Twelve months starting September 16th, since that's when you'd get access for setup. It runs through September 15th next year. Renewal is annual unless either side gives 30 days' notice.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: That's fine. Send the updated order form with 28 seats and the split billing. If it matches what we just said, I can route it for signature today.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Will do. You'll have it in about an hour, and I'll include the implementation dates in the same email so your ops lead has the timeline.
